sample_unit: clinicians (dermatology residents, ward nurses, medical students)
models_evaluated: convolutional neural network (CNN) for pressure injury classification

links.outcome: Pressure injury staging accuracy of participants without vs with CNN assistance
links.effect: Accuracy improved from 0.501 (95% CI 0.487-0.515) in Part I to 0.672 (95% CI 0.660-0.684) in Part II, a 17.1% improvement; Fleiss' kappa rose from 0.414 to 0.641.
links.quote: The accuracy of PI staging among participants was 0.501 (95% CI, 0.487-0.515) in Part I, improving by 17.1% to 0.672 (95% CI, 0.660-0.684) in Part II.

screen.reason: Evaluates a CNN for pressure injury staging in an offline reader study comparing clinician accuracy and concordance with and without AI assistance.

primary.practice: AI-assisted clinical decision support vs unassisted clinician review
